To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
NDN is an attractive architecture to realize the IoT vision because it enables the network to be configured to the application, rather than vice versa.

NDN is a promising architecture for the Internet of Things because it aligns application and networking semantics, and provides security, naming, and mobility features that are essential for the Internet of Everything.

Named Data Networking (a future Internet architecture that uses data names as the basis for all network operations) is a promising approach for realizing the Internet of Things (a vision for interconnecting the world's "smart things" through a common network infrastructure) in a more secure and straightforward manner than existing approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation, and deployment of NDN-based IoT systems.
the following questions: How does NDN help achieve IoT? What is the current state of NDN for IoT? What are the next steps?
developing the NDN architecture, protocols, and implementations to enable a more secure and scalable Internet of Things.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NDN is a promising approach for the IoT.
NDN can be used as a building block to enable IoT.
NDN is a good candidate architecture for the Internet of Things, and that NDN is an excellent choice for the IoT in many cases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IoT vision is a perfect fit for NDN.
NDN provides an innovative, secure, and efficient communication architecture that can enable the IoT vision.
NDN is an ideal architecture for IoT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NDN can be used to enable IoT applications and services that are not feasible or practical to deploy with current IP-based solutions.
NDN is an ideal candidate to enable IoT, as it provides a simple and scalable way to build a global IoT infrastructure.
NDN can be an effective and efficient platform for realizing the IoT vision, and that the IoT community should explore the use of NDN for this purpose.
